intro: Your people, survivors of a great cataclysm, have found refuge on this untamed planet.
You must build a new civilization, facing the wrath of nature and the unknown horrors that lurk in the shadows.
The whispers of ancient myths speak of powerful artifacts and forgotten knowledge that can aid you.
But beware, for the stars hold secrets both wondrous and terrifying.

text: The first few seasons are harsh. Storms batter your fledgling settlement, and resources are scarce.
Elder Mira speaks of an ancient Obelisk, said to possess the power to calm the storms.
The scout Aric Stonebeard confirms the rumors. An Obelisk stands in the distance, radiating a strange energy.
But monstrous creatures guard it, drawn to its power.
You have built the Obelisk! Its power resonates through your settlement, calming the storms.
Zane, drawn by the Obelisk's energy, arrives. He believes he can unlock its secrets.
But the Obelisk has also attracted unwanted attention... from beyond this world.
Xylar, an alien ambassador, appears. They offer knowledge and trade, but warn of greater dangers in the galaxy.
